author: SickProdigy
description: Link MyBB accounts and membership roles through External Sign-In, with optional owner-controlled API-v1 announcements and reviewed forum publishing.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each guild's independent External Sign-In URL, membership mappings/synchronization state, optional API-v1 board settings, publisher-role and forum allowlists, and announcement routes/cursors. For linked members it stores verified issuer/subject/link metadata, status/timestamps/errors, and cog-owned role IDs. API tokens, External Sign-In client credentials, and member link credentials are stored separately in Red shared API tokens and removed through their corresponding deliberate disconnect or user-data deletion flow.
install_msg: For membership roles, run `[p]mybbset membership setup` and configure External Sign-In. The Discord server owner may optionally run `[p]mybbset setup` for API-v1 announcements and reviewed forum publishing. See the README for the required private-plugin setup order.
name: MyBB
short: MyBB account linking, membership roles, announcements, and reviewed publishing
